   383	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   384	# Sparse byte store
   385	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   386	
   387	
   388	class ByteStore:
   389	    """Sparse byte storage with overlap policy, contiguity and rollback.
   390	
   391	    Bytes are kept as a sorted list of disjoint, non-adjacent chunks so that
   392	    very large sparse offsets stay cheap.  Every mutation returns an undo
   393	    callable so that a failed packet can be rolled back atomically.
   394	    """
   395	
   396	    __slots__ = ("starts", "chunks", "contig", "delivered")
   397	
   398	    def __init__(self):
   399	        self.starts = []
   400	        self.chunks = {}
   401	        self.contig = 0
   402	        self.delivered = bytearray()
   403	
   404	    # -- reading -----------------------------------------------------------
   405	    def read(self, offset, length):
   406	        """Return `length` bytes at `offset`, or None when not fully stored."""
   407	        if length <= 0:
   408	            return b""
   409	        starts = self.starts
   410	        chunks = self.chunks
   411	        out = bytearray()
   412	        pos = offset
   413	        end = offset + length
   414	        i = bisect.bisect_right(starts, offset) - 1
   415	        if i < 0:
   416	            i = 0
   417	        while pos < end and i < len(starts):
   418	            start = starts[i]
   419	            chunk = chunks[start]
   420	            stop = start + len(chunk)
   421	            if stop <= pos:
   422	                i += 1
   423	                continue
   424	            lo = pos if pos > start else start
   425	            hi = stop if stop < end else end
   426	            out += chunk[lo - start : hi - start]
   427	            pos = hi
   428	            i += 1
   429	        if len(out) != length:
   430	            return None
   431	        return bytes(out)
   432	
   433	    # -- writing -----------------------------------------------------------
   434	    def insert(self, offset, data, policy):
   435	        """Store `data` at `offset`; raise ConflictError on a rejected clash."""
   436	        size = len(data)
   437	        if size == 0:
   438	            return _noop
   439	        end = offset + size
   440	        starts = self.starts
   441	        chunks = self.chunks
   442	
   443	        index = bisect.bisect_right(starts, offset) - 1
   444	        if index < 0:
   445	            index = 0
   446	        overlapping = []
   447	        while index < len(starts) and starts[index] < end:
   448	            start = starts[index]
   449	            chunk = chunks[start]
   450	            if start + len(chunk) > offset:
   451	                overlapping.append(index)
   452	            index += 1
   453	
   454	        merged = bytearray(data)
   455	        removed = []
   456	        for index in overlapping:
   457	            start = starts[index]
   458	            chunk = chunks[start]
   459	            removed.append((start, chunk))
   460	            lo = start if start > offset else offset
   461	            hi = start + len(chunk)
   462	            if hi > end:
   463	                hi = end
   464	            if hi > lo:
   465	                old_seg = chunk[lo - start : hi - start]
   466	                new_seg = merged[lo - offset : hi - offset]
   467	                if old_seg != new_seg:
   468	                    if policy == "reject":
   469	                        raise ConflictError()
   470	                    merged[lo - offset : hi - offset] = old_seg
   471	
   472	        new_items = []
   473	        for start, chunk in removed:
   474	            if start < offset:
   475	                new_items.append((start, chunk[: offset - start]))
   476	            if start + len(chunk) > end:
   477	                new_items.append((end, chunk[end - start :]))
   478	        new_items.append((offset, bytes(merged)))
   479	
   480	        if overlapping:
   481	            first = overlapping[0]
   482	            last = overlapping[-1] + 1
   483	            for start, _chunk in removed:
   484	                del chunks[start]
   485	            del starts[first:last]
   486	            position = first
   487	        else:
   488	            position = bisect.bisect_left(starts, offset)
   489	
   490	        added = []
   491	        for start, chunk in new_items:
   492	            chunks[start] = chunk
   493	            added.append(start)
   494	        starts[position:position] = sorted(added)
   495	
   496	        old_contig = self.contig
   497	        old_delivered = len(self.delivered)
   498	        self._extend_contiguous()
   499	
   500	        def undo():
   501	            for start in added:
   502	                chunks.pop(start, None)
   503	                idx = bisect.bisect_left(starts, start)
   504	                while idx < len(starts) and starts[idx] < start:
   505	                    idx += 1
   506	                if idx < len(starts) and starts[idx] == start:
   507	                    del starts[idx]
   508	            for start, chunk in removed:
   509	                chunks[start] = chunk
   510	                bisect.insort(starts, start)
   511	            self.contig = old_contig
   512	            del self.delivered[old_delivered:]
   513	
   514	        return undo

   518	        chunks = self.chunks
